item.description:
0.11.1

The grey suggestion now sits where your cursor is.

  • It drifted further right the longer your line got. We measured the cell width but never snapped it to the pixel grid the way the terminal engine does, so every column was off by a fraction and the fractions added up — 9pt by column 40 at Menlo 12pt, wider than a character. The direction flipped with font size, which made it look random.
  • The first suggestion you ever see now ends in a faint →, which is the key that accepts it. The hint disappears once you have used it.
  • Tab is not that key and will not become it — Tab belongs to the shell or device on the far end, and taking it would remove the completion you already had.
